literal_meaning: লব (ছোট আঙুল) + ডঙ্কা (ছোট বা তুচ্ছ অংশ); ছোট আঙুল বা তুচ্ছ কিছু
figurative_meaning_en: Nothing at all; zilch; getting the short end or nothing in a share
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে সবাই খাবার পেল, কিন্তু আমার ভাগ্যে লবডঙ্কা।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone got some food at the party, but I drew the labdanka.
I tried to win the lottery but ended up with zilch.
note: Refers to the little finger as a symbol of insignificance in dividing shares, common in Bengali folk expressions.
